primary_sources.title: Secant sheaves and Weil classes on abelian varieties
primary_sources.routing_fact: Formulates the split-Weil-type deformation mechanism and surveys the sixfold split result; split type is the known source geometry used by the secant-sheaf construction.

primary_sources.author: Amir Mostaed
primary_sources.title: McMullen's Curve, the Weil Locus, and the Hodge Conjecture for Abelian Sixfolds
primary_sources.routing_fact: At the studied sixfold Weil-locus intersection points, the Hodge-Weil classes are absolute Hodge but are described as inaccessible to existing algebraicity theorems because of CM isolation, absence of K-secant structure, and uncontrolled discriminant; remaining open steps are isolated.
July 2026 result concerns abelian fourfolds of Weil type, not a general all-discriminant sixfold theorem.

scope_statement: This is a routing classification, not a proof that the selected Weil classes are non-algebraic. It states only that the declared discriminant -3 very-general sixfold family is not covered by the checked sixfold algebraicity theorems and remains a legitimate open-frontier benchmark at the stated literature freeze.
